title: Iulus son of Ascanius
summary: Raleigh names Iulus son of Ascanius in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Iulus, the sonne of Ascanius, who held the Priesthood when the people gaue the Kingdome to Syluius Posthumus. He is not Ascanius, whose surname was also Iulus. The one-word title would fold onto that surname, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
